title: AI Engineer or ML Engineer? Pick Wrong and It Costs You
description: AI engineer and ML engineer sound like the same job, but one of them gets the big checks and the other one gets the door open, and picking the wrong one can cost you.
We walk through what each role really does day to day, which one fits your background, and the US pay data behind a $340,000 gap between the typical engineer and the top 10%.
